import subprocess,pathlib,sys,random
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); ours=[sys.executable,'xsv_port.py']; p=pathlib.Path('probe')
def cmp(args,data=None):
 a=subprocess.run([ref,*args],input=data,capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run([*ours,*args],input=data,capture_output=True)
 if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)"'!=(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr):
  print('"'FAIL',args,'REF',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr),'OUR',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr)); return 1
 return 0
fail=0
# empty and quoting
for raw in [b'',b'\\n',b'\"\"\\n',b'a\\n\"\"\\n',b'a,b\\n,\\n',b'a,b\\n\"x\\ny\",z\\n',b'a,b\\r\\n1,2\\r\\n']:
 (p/'edge.csv').write_bytes(raw)
 for cmd in [['fmt',str(p/'edge.csv')],['count',str(p/'edge.csv')],['table',str(p/'edge.csv')],['slice',str(p/'edge.csv')]]: fail+=cmp(cmd)
# selection suite
sels=['h1','h1[0]','h1[1]','\"h[]3\"','h1-h4','h1[1]-h1[0]','"'!3'"','4-','-2','1,1','']
for s in sels: fail+=cmp(['select','--',s,str(p/'select.csv')])
# stats cases
cases=[[b'1',b'2'],[b'1.5',b'2.8'],[b'1.5',b'2'],[b'1.5',b'hi',b'2.8'],[b'',b'5',b'15',b'10'],[b'a',b'b',b'a'],[b'1',b'2',b'3',b'4'],[b'01',b'1e2',b'-3']]
for vals in cases:
 (p/'edge.csv').write_bytes(b'h\\n'+b''.join((b'\"\"' if v==b'' else v)+b'\\n' for v in vals))
 fail+=cmp(['stats','--everything',str(p/'edge.csv')]); fail+=cmp(['stats','--everything','--nulls',str(p/'edge.csv')])
# table options
(p/'edge.csv').write_bytes(b'a,bbbb,c\\nxx,y,zzz\\n')
for opts in [[],['-w','1'],['-w','8'],['-p','0'],['-p','5'],['-c','0'],['-c','2']]: fail+=cmp(['table',*opts,str(p/'edge.csv')])
print('failures',fail)
